decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the firm's core coolant-management business, the booster system is highly related to existing engineering, service and R&D knowledge, so the firm is more likely to refine it than withdraw it.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's established filtration and process-media capabilities, and a large German machinery producer with in-house R&D can absorb field feedback and improve it commercially.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's conveying and automation base, and after keeping it through 2024 the firm would typically continue learning from installed applications rather than exit quickly.

The hinged belt chip conveyor remains well aligned with the firm's existing conveyor know-how and customer base, so strong absorptive capacity and a growing market support retention with incremental development.
